zoe-cs: Quick heads-up — Nimbus Health onboarding is blocked. Their web integration fails at SDK init: first request gets a 401, then a bunch of 429s. They can’t get a sample generate working. Logs below from their staging run.

zoe-cs: ```
[2026-03-20T14:02:10Z] web-sdk:init auth error 401 missing header "X-Client-Tag"
[2026-03-20T14:02:12Z] web-sdk:request retry=1 429 rate_limiter remaining=0 limit=120/min Retry-After=25
[2026-03-20T14:02:13Z] web-sdk:request retry=2 429 rate_limiter remaining=0
```

james-sdk: Which SDK version are they on? CDN vs packaged build matters — CDN builds sometimes get post-processing that strips custom headers. Ask them to paste the tiny init snippet (the one that calls `new Redwood({ key: ... })`). Also enable `DEBUG=redwood:*` and share console output.

zoe-cs: They sent this snippet — using web SDK 0.9.4 via CDN: 
```js
// client-side code in index.html
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: window.NIMBUS_KEY });
client.generate({ prompt: 'hi' })
  .then(res => console.log(res))
  .catch(e => console.error(e));
```
No custom headers set on their side. They said CloudFront + a service worker are in front of the site.

sam-dev: That service worker + CloudFront combo rings bells — service workers can rewrite or drop `X-` headers, and some CDNs strip headers by default for security. Also looks like their CI runs many parallel smoke tests which trigger the minute quota. Two separate issues: missing client header (causes 401 from our auth proxy) + parallel preflight fanout (causes 429).

kevin-infra: Checked our gateway logs for that org: we see `x-rw-ratelimit-remaining: 0` and `retry-after: 21` on the bursts. Also many short-lived connections — connection reuse not happening, so each request counts separately. Immediate mitigations: 1) temp per-minute quota bump for Nimbus to unblock onboarding, 2) ask them to switch the key usage to a server-side token for bulk initialization (avoid client-side fanout), 3) advise enabling keep-alive / connection pooling in their environment. I can apply the quota bump for 2 hours.

ops-bot: Temporary quota increase applied to org_nimbus (per-minute +50) until 2026-03-20T16:00:00Z. Audit log updated.

maria-cs: Nimbus is flagged as a renewal risk if blocked >48h. They’re anxious; offering a 1-week trial extension and pairing session would help. Can we prioritize a 30min joint debug call today? I’ll coordinate scheduling.

james-sdk: On the SDK side I’ll add a clearer error when `X-Client-Tag` or required client header is missing (instead of generic 401), and add a small client-side backoff with jitter for 429s. PR will be tiny, I’ll target a patch release (0.9.5) and a quick note in release notes. Also add a troubleshooting checklist to docs: mention service-worker header passthrough and CDN header allow list.

zoe-cs: Thanks — I’ll send the checklist + pre-call repro steps to Nimbus and book the pairing slot. Maria — please send the trial extension voucher copy for me to share. cc @james-sdk @kevin-infra

sam-dev: Suggested quick client-side workaround to Nimbus until SDK patch: move the API call to a simple serverless function that proxies one request (keeps apiKey server-side) — avoids header stripping and reduces parallel client connections. Example curl they can test: 
```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $SERVER_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```

zoe-cs: Perfect. I’ll forward that snippet. Will report back after the call. :thumbsup:
